headline_seed: Republicans, reeling from an election drubbing, will choose their leadership in Congress - NBC News
draft_text:
House Republicans elected Jim Jordan as minority leader Tuesday, 106-73 over Steve Scalise, per AP and NBC News.
Jordan, 62, co-founded the House Freedom Caucus and chairs Judiciary.
The vote follows a midterm that cost Republicans more than 40 House seats.

And that's the mews.
